title: gouldia terminalis var. ovata
intro: Gouldia terminalis var. ovata, commonly known as the Hawaiian Sandalwood, is a type of flowering plant in the heath family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to promote relaxation and reduce stress, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
